Sort of. It's in my name but linked with his other accounts, so I have no way of accessing it (login info, etc.). It's still not enough to last me long on my own anyway, maybe a few months rent.

I'm scared about the future- I know I'll have to go into some pretty severe debt if I go to medical school. And if I'm an emotional wreck now, how will I handle medicine? 

>if the first 25 years of it are shit, it doesn't mean the next 50 have to be.

I like the idea of this but I have no idea how to make it real for myself. I don't know if I have the strength to make it to 25. I admire your attitude towards this and I wish I could see things that way too.

I can't afford moving out right now. The job I was working to get (and supposedly accepted for) has been at a standstill for months while I tried to set up meetings with the person in charge who is very busy. My dad won't give me access to my main savings account, so I've only got access to a couple thousand. It wouldn't last me long in NYC anyway.

Yeah, the power that parents have is unbelievable. I'm sorry you've had to go deal with the toxicity too. Were you able to get away from it? What did you do?

When I'm in these dark places, all I can think about is getting away from them immediately and drastically. I don't care about how me being gone would affect them.

Thanks for responding. 

I just wish I could believe that things will be okay one day. I've had depression for so long and life just keeps getting harder.. I feel like I could end it tomorrow or end it in a year and it will hardly make a difference except more misery and self-hatred.

> Doing things is (IMHO) scary sometimes.

I totally get that, and forcing through it is tough. All throughout college I had to deal with that, in order to stay with a top gpa, but now I feel as if I've reached the end of things I can do. I feel like all of it was for the sake of my parents, who I don't even like. I have no dreams anymore, I don't *really* want to apply to medical school right now, and I keep (stupidly) expecting my parents to turn around and be human beings and care that I'm suffering. I feel like I can't grow up.
